calls.video_title: Forget the NVIDIA Dip (3 Stocks That Are Actually Cheap)
calls.price_at_call: ~10% below all-time highs (no current price stated)
calls.thesis: Largest hospital network in the US, somewhat recession-proof (people need care in good times and bad), trading at 17x PE trailing and forward vs a 20x sector median while earnings are projected to more than triple over 10 years; strong Texas/Florida demographics. Political tailwinds: Democrats controlling Congress fighting to roll back Medicaid cuts, and Medicare for All on the table post-2028 if they hold power.
calls.base_case: Single-digit earnings growth in 2026-27, accelerating to double digits from 2028; a set-it-and-forget-it long-term hold.
calls.bull_case: 30x in ~15 years already; Medicaid rollback / Medicare for All tailwinds plus scale advantages compound over 5-10 years.
calls.bear_case: Politics cuts both ways — a Republican win or Congress shift in 2028 could pressure the story; the stock has had significant dips along the way despite the strong long-term chart.
